# Look In Map

![Look In Map function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/collection/map/04-look-map.svg)

[Collection functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Reads a value without insertion. key not found? distinguishes a missing key from a stored default-valued entry. The optional default preserves full V; unwired uses its typed default.
